row: 陶朱隱園位於臺北信義計畫區，由比利時建築師文森．卡利博設計，2018 年完工，地上 21 層、高 93.2 公尺，每層旋轉 4.5 度，種有約兩萬棵喬木與灌木。

airspace.zh: 台北市區多屬禁限航區（含松山機場周邊），飛行前請以民航局系統查詢；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Much of central Taipei is restricted airspace (Songshan Airport and more). This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

shw.note: north side at noon on 21 December

tagline.zh-Hant: 每層轉 4.5 度的綠色雙螺旋，冬至夕陽落在 101 旁
tagline.en: A green double helix turning 4.5° a floor; the winter sun sets beside Taipei 101

zh: 臺北信義計畫區，一棟扭轉的綠色大樓：
陶朱隱園。
en: In Taipei's Xinyi Planning District stands a twisting green tower:
Tao Zhu Yin Yuan.

zh: 由比利時建築師文森．卡利博設計，
2018 年完工，地上 21 層、高 93.2 公尺。
en: It was designed by the Belgian architect Vincent Callebaut
and completed in 2018: 21 floors above ground, 93.2 m tall.

zh: 每一層樓旋轉 4.5 度，從底到頂共轉 90 度，
設計靈感來自 DNA 的雙螺旋。
en: Each floor turns 4.5°, 90° from bottom to top,
an idea taken from the double helix of DNA.

zh: 樓板邊緣種了約兩萬棵喬木與灌木，
設計目標是每年吸收約 130 公噸的二氧化碳。
en: About 20,000 trees and shrubs line the floors,
meant to absorb about 130 tonnes of carbon dioxide a year.

zh: 全棟共 40 戶，每層 2 戶，最低的住宅在 3 樓；
頂樓設有直升機停機坪。
en: There are 40 homes, two to a floor, the lowest on the 3rd floor;
the roof has a helicopter pad.

zh: 日照：冬至的中午，臺北的太陽仰角約 42 度，
大樓的影子向北約 105 公尺。
en: Sun and shade: at noon on the winter solstice Taipei's sun is about 42° up,
and the shadow reaches about 105 m to the north.

zh: 夏至的中午，臺北就在北回歸線旁，
太陽仰角約 88 度，大樓幾乎沒有影子。
en: At noon on the summer solstice — Taipei lies just north of the Tropic of Cancer —
the sun is about 88° up and the tower casts almost no shadow.

banner.zh: 虛構的示意樣品屋・非實際格局
banner.en: Fictional mock-up flat · not an actual layout

zh: 以下是虛構的示意樣品屋，約在 70 公尺高，
窗戶面向西南，正對著台北 101。
en: What follows is a fictional mock-up flat, about 70 m up,
with its windows facing south-west, straight toward Taipei 101.

banner.zh: 虛構的示意樣品屋・非實際格局
banner.en: Fictional mock-up flat · not an actual layout

zh: 冬至的傍晚，夕陽落在台北 101 的右邊，
整片信義區染成金色。
en: On the evening of the winter solstice the sun sets just right of Taipei 101,
and the whole Xinyi district turns gold.

zh: 它離台北 101 約 780 公尺，
四周是信義計畫區的辦公大樓與百貨公司。
en: It stands about 780 m from Taipei 101,
among the office towers and department stores of the Xinyi district.

zh: 它取得美國 LEED 黃金級的綠建築認證，
也獲得世界高層建築與都市人居學會 2015 年的獎項。
en: It holds a LEED Gold green-building rating
and received a 2015 award from the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat.

zh: 本片為示意畫面：建築為簡化模型，樣品屋為虛構，
非建商官方資料、非廣告；日照依當天計算。
en: Illustration: the buildings are simplified models and the flat is fictional;
not developer material or an advertisement. The light follows that day's sun.

banner.en: Illustration · not developer material · not an advertisement
